meta.title: Book in Cambodia
meta.description: Find any book in Cambodia: see which bookstores, libraries and sellers have it, or order it from abroad. A free, non-profit, open source directory.

home.badge: Non-profit · Free for everyone · Open source
home.lead: Search once and see every store, library and seller that has it.
home.howLead: Three steps from "I want this book" to holding it.
home.step1Text: By title, author or ISBN, in English or Khmer.
home.step2Title: See where it is in Cambodia
home.step2Text: Bookstores, second-hand sellers and libraries, with price and contact.
home.step3Text: Contact a book-buying service that brings it in for you.
home.categoriesLead: From Khmer classics to learning English.

faq.a: No. We show you which stores, sellers and libraries have a book, and you contact them directly. We never take a commission.

faq.q: Is it free to list my bookstore?
faq.a: Yes, always. Every store is listed free and equally, and nobody can pay to be shown first.

faq.q: How up to date are prices and stock?
faq.a: Each listing shows when it was last checked. Listings older than six months are marked as possibly outdated, so contact the store to confirm.
Add books you see in stores, check store details, translate pages into Khmer, or help build the site on GitHub.

home.ctaText: Book-buying services can order it from abroad and deliver it to you here. Or tell us which book you're looking for.

abroad.lead: Can't find a book in Cambodia? These services order books from other countries and deliver them to you here.
abroad.step1Text: Message a service on Telegram or Facebook.
abroad.step2Text: Book price, shipping and service fee.
abroad.disclaimer: Book in Cambodia doesn't sell books, handle payments or take commissions. Services are listed free by the community; agree on price and delivery with them directly.
